title: Rust: Grade Calculator
description: Convert numerical scores to letter grades using conditionals.

steps.title: Basic Grade Function
steps.description: Write a function `letter_grade(score: i32) -> &'static str` that returns: >= 90 "A", >= 80 "B", >= 70 "C", >= 60 "D", else "F". Call with 85.
hints: Use `else if` chain in order from highest to lowest.

steps.title: Multiple Grades
steps.description: Print grades for scores [95, 82, 73, 58, 100] using the letter_grade function in a loop.
hints: Loop through the array with a for loop.

steps.title: Grade with +/-
steps.description: Add + and - modifiers: >= 97 = A+, >= 93 = A, >= 90 = A-, >= 87 = B+, etc. Call with 88 and 72.
hints: Check for - modifier: score % 10 <= 3 (and not at boundary)

steps.title: Pass/Fail Check
steps.description: Write a function `is_passing(score: i32) -> bool` that returns true if score >= 60. Test with scores [45, 75, 30, 90] and print which pass.
hints: Loop through scores, check each one.
Print "75 passes" or "45 fails" for each.

verification.failureMessage: Print which scores pass and which fail.

steps.title: Class Average and Grade
steps.description: Given scores [88, 92, 75, 63, 98], calculate the class average and print the letter grade for the average.

verification.failureMessage: Calculate average (83) and print its letter grade (B).
